add.full: @{songqueue:user} the song queue is full right now.
add.quota: @{songqueue:user} you are at your song limit ({songqueue:limit} in the queue at once). !sr remove frees a slot.
cleared: The song queue has been cleared.
current.req: Now playing on Spotify: {songqueue:title} by {songqueue:artist} (asked by {songqueue:req})
err.upstream: @{songqueue:user} the music lookup is down right now, try again in a bit.
next.pending: Skip sent to Spotify. The request queue will update when playback changes.
remove.not_found: There is no song at position #{songqueue:pos}.
retract.none: @{songqueue:user} you don't have a queued song to remove.
search.none: @{songqueue:user} no track found for that. Try a Spotify link or "artist - song".
sr.off: @{songqueue:user} song requests from chat are turned off right now.
sr.perm: @{songqueue:user} song requests are limited to a smaller group right now.
sr.offline: @{songqueue:user} song requests only work while the stream is live.
status.current_only: Now playing: {songqueue:title} (asked by {songqueue:req}). Nothing else queued. !sr <song> to add one!
